iraq.tc-safa.fibreglass-retail.access: Mosul-based online technical-materials retailer lists fibreglass reinforcement products and resin with item numbers and IQD prices. The listed fabric construction/orientation, resin chemistry and cure system, price validity, freight, tax basis, rail qualification and bulk-order pricing are not established.
